Name: Animated Starlight
Information:
**Animated Starlight**

Various stars across the galaxy are imbued with divine power from one source or another. Somnus Domina’s own sun, Arco, is connected to the Eidolon Harros and several other lesser deities. Sometimes convolutions of this influence and sparks from the elemental planes can create exolunar elementals, which animated starlight falls under. Photons and arcane power come together, forming into a lighting bundle of stars that freely builds and rebuilds bodies for itself out of its ephemeral mass. These flickers of living light are irritating to exolunar vessels due to their ability to pass through a ship’s hull, terrorizing its inhabitants intentionally or not.

**Elemental Traits**

An elemental does not need to eat, drink, or breathe.

traits.name: Illuminated Body
traits.description: The animated starlight shines bright light 10 feet in every direction, and dim light twice as far. The bright glare generated by the animated starlight causes all creatures to have disadvantage on attacks made against it from 20 feet away or further.

actions.name: Burning Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, 5 feet, targets each creature in range with the same roll. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Starflash
actions.description: The animated starlight lets off a flash of bright light, forcing each creature within 10 feet of it to make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the animated starlight’s next turn.
